_about: Animated mobs: each an item on an armour stand's head, leather horse armour with this custom model data (from 100001, above every item's), its model a Blockbench model in mobs/models/ whose animations the item shader plays (build_mobs.py bakes them into the model's texture, the mobs stitch plays them). The item's dye names the clip, by the ids here, and when it started. clips are by the model's animation names; end is how a clip ends where the model's own loop setting isn't what the mob wants (loop, once: back to rest, hold: its last frame). scale is the model's size on the stand's head (at most 4). textures swaps the model's textures, by their names in it, for PNGs in mobs/textures/: the same model and animations as another mob in its own colours. The release publishes mobs.json (each mob's custom model data, clip ids, ticks and a hitbox fitted to the model), which the plugin reads: a mob type names its mob here in entity_info's animated.
